# KP Packaging

> KP Packaging is a Mumbai-based manufacturer and distributor of coated papers and flexible packaging with over 30 years of experience. The company runs extrusion coating and lamination machines from Korea, China and the United States of America at its plant in Silvassa, India, and supplies pharmaceutical, food & beverage, FMCG and medical or surgical packaging to around 500 clients across about 25 countries.

Founded: 1990. Head office: A to Z Industrial Estate, Western Wing, Office No 143, Ganpat Rao Kadam Marg, Lower Parel, Mumbai, 400013. Plant: 792, Apple Insulated, Nr Crown Tapes, Vaibhav Laxmi, Silvassa, India, 396193.
Contact: prem@kppackaging.com / +91 85916 56966.

## Products
- [Glassine Paper](https://kppackaging.com/products/glassine-paper/): Smooth, super-calendered barrier paper for pharmaceutical packaging.
- [MG Poster Paper](https://kppackaging.com/products/mg-poster-paper/): Glossy, high-strength poly-coated paper, a best-seller for primary packaging.
- [Chromo Paper](https://kppackaging.com/products/chromo-paper/): Water-resistant, high-gloss coated paper built for premium print.
- [Cupstock Paper](https://kppackaging.com/products/cupstock-paper/): Food-safe paper for hot & cold cups, bowls and food service.
- [3 Ply Paper](https://kppackaging.com/products/3-ply-paper/): Lightweight, leak-proof foil laminate for maximum freshness.
- [4 Ply Paper](https://kppackaging.com/products/4-ply-paper/): An extra polymer layer for the toughest pharma & pan-masala barriers.
- [MG Kraft Paper](https://kppackaging.com/products/mg-kraft/): High-strength, eco-friendly kraft with a glossy machine-glazed top.
- [MF Craft Paper](https://kppackaging.com/products/mf-craft-paper/): Cost-efficient kraft with rough machine-finished texture on both sides.
- [Folding Box Board](https://kppackaging.com/products/folding-box-board/): Low-density, high-stiffness board with a superb print surface.
- [Duplex Board](https://kppackaging.com/products/duplex-board/): Rigid, anti-curl coated board with a bright, print-ready face.
- [Non-Woven / Non-Tearable Paper](https://kppackaging.com/products/non-tearable-paper/): Synthetic, breathable, tear-proof, the strength of paper, film and fabric.
- [PE Stiffener Paper](https://kppackaging.com/products/pe-coated-stiffener-paper/): Rigid PE-coated stiffener for shape, support and moisture protection.
- [Greaseproof Paper](https://kppackaging.com/products/greaseproof-paper/): Oil-resistant cellulose paper for butter wraps and food packaging.
- [Paper Lid](https://kppackaging.com/products/paper-lid/): Multi-GSM paper lids for hot food packed in aluminium foil containers.
- [Anti-Skid Paper](https://kppackaging.com/products/anti-skid-paper/): Non-slip paper that locks pallet layers and trays in place.
- [Liquid Packaging Board](https://kppackaging.com/products/liquid-packaging-board/): Multi-layer board for gable-top and aseptic liquid packaging.
- [Butcher Paper](https://kppackaging.com/products/butcher-paper/): Strong kraft-style wrapping paper for meat packaging.
- [Medical Grade Paper](https://kppackaging.com/products/medical-grade-paper/): Virgin wood-based paper for sterile medical device packaging.
- [Butter Packaging](https://kppackaging.com/products/butter-packaging/): Greaseproof and foil laminate for butter, cheese and oily foods.
- [Maplitho Paper](https://kppackaging.com/products/maplitho-paper/): Eco-friendly, wood-free printing & writing paper.
- [Tissue Paper](https://kppackaging.com/products/tissue-paper/): Soft, absorbent, hygienic tissue from recycled pulp.
- [Bactide Paper](https://kppackaging.com/products/bactite/): Steam-sterilizable, bacterial-barrier paper for medical packaging.
- [Grid Coated Paper](https://kppackaging.com/products/grid-lacquer/): Breathable grid-coated medical paper for heat-seal sterile packs.
